stem: What is the number of union territories in India ?
expl: When the question was asked, India comprise 28 states and 7 Union Territories. Presently India comprises 28 states and 8 Union Territories. The 8 Union Territories are - National Capital Territory of Delhi, Chandigarh, Lakshadweep, Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu, Puducherry, Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh.

stem: The largest Union Territory of India is –
expl: The area of Union Territories given in the above question in decreasing order is as follows: (Union Territory) (Area sq.km) NCT of Delhi - 1483 Puducherry - 490 Chandigarh - 114 Daman and Diu - 111 Hence, Delhi has the largest area among the Union Territories in the given options. Note : NCT of Delhi is also the largest Union Territory in terms of population. According to the situation as of January 26, 2020 Ladakh is the largest Union Territory of India in terms of area.

stem: Which is the smallest Union Territory of India?
expl: Lakshadweep is the smallest Union Territory of India, having an area of 32 sq. km with a population of 64473. According to the situation as of January 26, 2020 India's largest (area) Union territory is Ladakh.

stem: Which one of the following is not a Union Territory?
expl: Tripura is not a Union Territory. It is a State. The rest of the given options are Union Territories. Tripura is surrounded by Bangladesh on three sides.

stem:
Which of the following statements are correct about Daman & Diu?
(i) It was under British Possession after independence.
(ii) Gulf of Khambhat is located between Daman and Diu.
(iii) Its Capital is Daman.
Code :
expl: Daman and Diu (when the question was asked) is a Union Territory of India. It is divided into two parts Daman (on the Arabian sea coastline of Maharashtra and Gujarat) and Diu (Saurashtra, coast of Gujarat). Its capital is Daman and Gulf of Khambhat is located between Daman and Diu. Daman was acquired by the Portuguese from Shah of Gujarat. Thereafter it was under the rule of Portuguese (not the British) until its liberation in 1961. So option (b) is the correct answer.

stem: Part of which state of the country is not included in National Capital Region?
expl: The National Capital Region (NCR) is a central planning region centered upon the National Capital Territory of Delhi in India. It encompasses the entire NCT of Delhi and several districts surrounding it from the states of Haryana, Uttar Pradesh and Rajasthan. Hence Madhya Pradesh is not a part of the NCR.
